verdict.rationale: A GPU ships with first-party driver and companion software (the evidence mentions the NVIDIA app), so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack contains no documentation of telemetry or usage-tracking controls. The 'fully private' claim concerns running AI models locally, which is an adjacent privacy feature and not an opt-out from telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
